description: Fetch the live gas price from public RPC nodes on Base or Ethereum: wei per unit gas, converted to gwei, with a USD estimate for a standard 21,000-gas transfer using your own ETH price input. No API key needed. Use this when an agent needs to current gas price in gwei and USD, straight from the chain. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: crypto_gas_price
title: Live Gas Price
